items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The agent I had, he wasn’t doing anything to support my career, but he was taking the money that was offered for my engagements. That was Jimmy Evans.

ctx.x: . . . because I didn’t want to do that. I wanted to work with my career. I didn’t have an agent, so how was I going to work? The agent I had, he wasn’t doing anything to support my career, but he was taking the money that was offered for my engagements. That was Jimmy Evans.
Jimmy Evans, a famous guy, at the time.
